def transform(grid):
    n=len(grid)
    a=[list(row) for row in grid]
    cw=[[a[n-1-j][i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    ccw=[[a[j][n-1-i] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    half=[[a[n-1-i][n-1-j] for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    return [a[i]+cw[i] for i in range(n)]+[ccw[i]+half[i] for i in range(n)]
